# Event

## Event Attributes

Describes generic event attributes.

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="event-id" href="#event-id">`event.id`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The unique identifier of an event in the source runtime. [1] | `evt_01J2K3M4N5P6Q7R8S9T0` |
| <a id="event-parent-id" href="#event-parent-id">`event.parent.id`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The identifier of the parent event in the source runtime. [2] | `evt_01J2K3M4N5P6Q7R8S9SZ` |

**[1] `event.id`:** This attribute represents an identifier assigned by the originating system, not by OpenTelemetry. It can be used to correlate events across log records or to deduplicate events from the same source.

**[2] `event.parent.id`:** This attribute is intended for event graphs where the source runtime provides parent-child relationships between events, such as a tool result pointing back to the tool call that produced it.
